verdict.why: Left has the brief's defining features: a stone base, timber-framed upper floors that jetty outward, a glowing window, a balcony with a telescope, lanterns and a tall conical roof. Right is a clean, well-finished tower, but it is a straight gray shaft with a neat roof and no jetty, timber framing, crookedness or visible balcony, so it reads as a generic tower rather than a crooked wizard tower.
